name: savvy-progress
description: Progress bar above the prompt for /savvy-flow, plus an agents panel (/agents-info): running, finished and planned subagents with model, task progress, context, cost and time.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en, ru, he (Hebrew, drawn right to left) or es

autoOpen.title: Open the agents panel
autoOpen.description: savvy: when a savvy-flow worker starts or a plan is reported; any: also when any other subagent starts

terminalCrabs.title: Crabs in the terminal
terminalCrabs.description: row: a pixel crab beside each agent; stage: the running agents' crabs at full size above the list; off: text only

reportSteps.title: Ask agents for their steps
reportSteps.description: savvy: only savvy-flow workers are asked to report their steps; any: every subagent is asked, when the step tool is among its tools

costumes.title: Costume per agent type
costumes.description: type=costume pairs, comma-separated (for example explorador=explore,revisor=heavy): the costume (fable, heavy, careful, medium, light, explore or other) an agent type wears; any other agent dresses for its savvy tier, or its model and effort
